summary: Iteration 20 — new Integrations BENTO + mobile cross-link overflow fix + regression sweep all GREEN. Backend pytest suite 19/19 pass (test_fluxvex_api.py, iter20_results.xml). Frontend: home #integrations renders as the new bento grid — section-integrations present, integrations-qualifier visible, three supported cards (integration-card-google-ads, -meta-ads, -ga4) + two dashed Coming-soon cards (integration-card-linkedin-ads, -tiktok-ads with integration-soon-{linkedin-ads,tiktok-ads} chips reading 'Coming soon') + full-width More-channels card with integrations-more-cta. Google Ads card renders 6 mini equalizer bars + 'CONV +11.4%' chip. Meta Ads card renders a green animated sparkline (svg path present) + 'ROAS 2.1x' chip. LinkedIn/TikTok cards are rendered as DIVs (not <a>), confirmed non-navigable (tag=DIV, href=null). Supported cards navigate — Google Ads click → /integrations/google-ads. Hover produces y-shift (-translate-y-1) + indigo glow class. No horizontal overflow at 1440 (scrollWidth=clientWidth=1440). integrations-more-cta opens waitlist modal (dialog visible). CROSS-LINK FIX VERIFIED: /integrations/google-ads at 390px → document.scrollWidth=390 = clientWidth=390 (was 734 in iter-19). Hero report: hero-report-preview visible, 66 svg paths/polylines, 13 dashed strokes (Last-period line), CountUp settles to $48,210 / 1.24M / 34,880 / 1,204. Integration pages: google-ads has '$24,180' + '2.6x'; meta-ads has '$16,940'; ga4 has '21,480'. Waitlist E2E submitted (qa.bento.1792656600@testmail.dev) → 'You're on the list.' + 'Signup confirmed' + Done closes modal. Contact submit via contact-{name,email,message}-input + contact-submit-button → contact-success visible. Calculator shows 4 range sliders + Copy result button. Zero pageerror events observed on home or /integrations/google-ads.
